1.consolidated_definition: Ave lacustre del género Cladorhynchus, de cuello negro y patas largas, con tres dedos, que frecuenta las lagunas y sitios pantanosos, donde suele pescar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Lacustrine bird of the genus Cladorhynchus, characterized by a black neck and long legs with three toes, which frequents lagoons and marshy areas where it usually fishes.
